lines.text: Dan planned a treat at the top.
Three cold hours, nothing to eat.
Halfway up he was shivering and slow, even in his warm layers.
His body had nothing left to burn.
Here's the fix. In the cold, eat a small snack about every hour, before you feel hungry.
Food is fuel, and fuel makes heat.
Keep bars in an inside pocket so they don't freeze hard.
Save this before your next cold hike.
